method: Read the live GitHub Pages snapshot first (HTML executive summary plus /data/latest.json and /data/origination.json). For every active fixture the featured exact-name method left without a betting line, check HLTV match pages first, then Polymarket Gamma/directory pages, then previously documented esportsbook surfaces. Directory-displayed prices are recorded as directory displays, never copied into a snapshot. HLTV fan votes and Hotspawn picked_percent are never used as probabilities.

limitations: HLTV match pages do not publish a two-sided prematch bookmaker pair that this project can replay. The betting module observed on BAKS vs Azuolas was Stake casino advertising plus a fan vote. Fan votes stay excluded.
GG.BET, BetBoom, 1xBet, Marathonbet and EGamersWorld HTML continue to challenge or 403 automated runners (dated sweep in data/research/fbdc97d6/). Those blocks are unchanged.

Polymarket directory cents are the public listing, not the CLOB bid/ask midpoint the ladder requires. They are recorded here so a reader can check the claim that a market exists; they are not originated probabilities.

This session does not edit scripts/originate.py or data/origination.json. Closing a featured blank with a newly observed money line is the four-hour publisher's job on the next successful live collect.

The sandbox used to write this file has no direct egress to Hotspawn or bookmakers; live readings were taken with the page-fetch tool against the public Pages snapshot, HLTV, Polymarket and the Polymarket Gamma API.
